description: This file defines the interface LoanRescheduleRequestDataValidator, which specifies validation methods for different actions (create, approve, reject) related to loan rescheduling requests within the loan account module of the Fineract system.

classes.name: LoanRescheduleRequestDataValidator
classes.description: Interface for validating loan reschedule requests during creation, approval, rejection, and installment rescheduling.

methods.name: validateForCreateAction
methods.description: Validates data when creating a new loan reschedule request.

methods.name: validateForApproveAction
methods.description: Validates data when approving a loan reschedule request.

methods.name: validateForRejectAction
methods.description: Validates data when rejecting a loan reschedule request.

methods.name: validateReschedulingInstallment
methods.description: Validates a specific installment during rescheduling.
